name: leak-alarm
description: Notice a live credential crossing a tool boundary and make a human deal with it. Blocks credentials on the way out, alerts on credentials on the way in.
_comment: Standalone on purpose: this plugin needs no broker, no 1Password and no
daemon. It ships with sandbroker because it is the same idea one layer
out, and because it reuses sandbroker's notifier contract -- if a
notify_command is already configured there, this inherits it.
Requires python3 on PATH, standard library only.
